newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries higher, volume thin ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries higher, volume thin ahead of holiday.

text.p: * US Treasuries off day's highs, still higher in thin trade. * Trading technical, most players sidelined ahead of Xmas. * Turnover said to be extremely light. Long-end firm. * Retailers, money managers mostly out. Foreigners sidelined. * Monday's data mostly friendly, provide some underpinning.
